yardage.why: 17 plays 150 yd from its back-most mapped box against the card's 195 (Blue 125): no box at 195 yd in OSM or the 2024 photo (open item, the developer's call)

why_tall: the tallest crowns (65-77 m) are old-growth Douglas firs on the valley slope north of the course, 100-170 m outside the boundary (the McKenzie valley's old growth reaches such heights; the lidar may also read high on the steep slope)

default_aim.why: 12 drives along the edge of the McKenzie valley forest (photo); after merging main (2026-11-13) the game's default aim for a perfect drive finishes a few metres into OSM's woods on the right. Open item
